summary: Azitra, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an at-the-market sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners on September 28, 2026, permitting sales of common stock up to $3,503,232 under an existing Form S-3 shelf. A.G.P. acts as sales agent for a 3.0% cash fee plus expense reimbursement; sales occur on NYSE American or otherwise per Rule 415(a)(4). Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. This ordinary equity shelf takedown, not a special situation, offers no deal terms; watch dilution and trading liquidity as placement notices are delivered.
